Conclusion: binding one identity to one costly, non-transferable reputation makes fakes uneconomical.
One echo check ties each account to a public key, so copies share no credit. A tide of independent peer grades builds reputation slowly, and idle accounts decay, so bought status fades. Like a vine, reputation grows only through verifiable work, never by transfer. Random, non-colluding reviewers grade each task, and mutual grading among suspected fakes is discarded. Each fake must repeat the full costly work, while an honest agent pays once and reuses standing.
